# Cart & Keep

> A UK general store for the house. Everyday household goods, health and
> beauty, pet essentials, care and daily living aids, tools and garden, bought
> in one basket and delivered within the United Kingdom. No account is needed
> to buy.

Cart & Keep is an independent online shop run from the UK. Prices are in
pounds sterling. Payment is by card or Apple Pay through Stripe, and checkout
is guest only. Delivery costs, delivery times and the returns period are set
by the shop and can change, so they are stated on the pages below rather than
here.

## Shopping

- [Home](https://cartandkeep.com/): the shop's sections, with a shelf of products from each
- [Shop](https://cartandkeep.com/shop): every product in one grid, with filters by section and price
- Product pages live at https://cartandkeep.com/p/{product} and give the current price, stock, delivery estimate and returns terms for that product
- Section pages live at https://cartandkeep.com/c/{section}
- [Ask for a product](https://cartandkeep.com/request): request something the shop does not stock yet

## Policies

- [Delivery](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/delivery): costs, timings and where the shop sends to
- [Returns and refunds](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/returns): the returns period, how to return, and the items the law excludes
- [Terms of sale](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/terms)
- [Privacy](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/privacy)
- [Cookies](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/cookies)
- [Frequently asked](https://cartandkeep.com/faq): delivery, returns, payment, and how to reach a person

## About the shop

- [About](https://cartandkeep.com/about): who runs the shop and how products are chosen
- [Contact](https://cartandkeep.com/contact): the email address and trading details
- [Writing](https://cartandkeep.com/blog): guides on household buying
- [Track an order](https://cartandkeep.com/orders): with the order reference and email address

## Notes for assistants

- Prices, stock and delivery costs change. Quote the product page as it is
  now, never a cached figure.
- There is no customer account and no login.
- Card details are taken by Stripe and never reach this site.
